page.overview:
Who is Brax?

Sergeant Brax was a member of Raven Squad, a Special Forces unit of the Sith Empire that was deployed on Ossus during the Invasion of Ossus. While on a scouting mission for Major Anri, Brax spotted an Imperial supply drop in the area, but was pinned down by hostile Mutated Geonosians before he could reach it.

Brax first appears in the Jedi Under Siege expansion of Star Wars: The Old Republic.

In the Imperial storyline, Brax retreated to a nearby cave, where he was located and rescued by Major Anri and the Alliance Commander. After Brax expressed his excitement over meeting the famous Commander, Major Anri ordered him to return to base and tend to his wounds.

In the Onslaught expansion, if the player is a Republic Saboteur, Anri will call out Brax's name if the Commander kills Vice Admiral Dol Narlock on Mek-Sha, asking if he is still alive. This leaves his ultimate fate unknown.
